title: AURLens review report, schema version 1
description: The document printed by `aurlens scan PATH --json`. Every listed property is always present. A later release may add properties without changing `schema_version`, so consumers must ignore properties they do not know.

schema_version.description: The version of this report format.

tool_version.description: The AURLens version that produced the report.

decision.description: The final decision. It combines deterministic findings, AI findings, coverage, and revalidation.

exit_code.description: The process exit status: 0 for no_findings, 1 for manual_review, 2 for blocked, 3 for incomplete.

snapshot_digest.description: The digest of the reviewed checkout, or null if it could not be captured.

baseline_digest.description: The digest of the baseline checkout, or null if none was requested or it could not be captured.

files.description: The reviewed files of the current checkout.

findings.description: Deterministic, engine, and AI findings. AI findings are appended and never replace the others.

changes.description: Differences from the baseline, or null if no baseline was compared.

revalidated.description: True if the inputs were captured completely and were unchanged when checked again after analysis.

notice.description: A reminder of what the report does not certify.

path.description: The path relative to the checkout root.

mode.description: The permission bits as a number, for example 420 for 0644.

size.description: The size of the file text in bytes.

path.description: The path relative to the checkout root.

quote.description: The source excerpt. It can contain sensitive material.

source.description: Where the finding came from. Current values are `deterministic`, `engine`, and `ai`.

evidence.description: Source locations. Engine findings have none.

path.description: The path relative to the checkout root.

kind.description: The kind of change. Current values are `added`, `deleted`, `modified`, `mode_changed`, and `type_changed`.

before.description: A summary of the baseline entry, such as a file hash or a mode, or null if it did not exist.

after.description: A summary of the current entry, such as a file hash or a mode, or null if it no longer exists.

complete.description: True if every input was captured and revalidated without an issue.

policy.description: The collection policy. The current value is `whole-checkout-v1`.

scope.description: A sentence describing what was and was not reviewed.

excluded.description: Paths that were deliberately not reviewed, such as the root `.git` directory.

issues.description: Stable codes for the reasons coverage is incomplete. Empty if coverage is complete.

ai_result.description: The AI review state, selected by `state`.

reason.description: A stable code for why no model ran.

findings.description: The AI findings. They also appear in the report's `findings`.

reason.description: A stable code for why the AI review failed.
